d: Iran escalates tensions with the United States as the IRGC claims an attack on a U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain. The announcement follows explosions in southern Iran and reported attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran showcases its Kheibar missile and military arsenal, while an Iranian commander claims U.S. bunker-buster bombs failed to detonate. Army Chief Amir Hatami warns of heavier losses, as Donald Trump demands total victory and vows to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons. Josh Barnes tells you more on Firstpost Live.
